<!-- Cross-study clonotype comparison (REFERENCE_MATCH tables under intables/reference/).
     Included by Master_Summary_Report.qmd. Renders nothing - not even its heading - when the
     run had no --reference_samplesheet, so reports of runs without one are unchanged. -->

```{r}
#| label: reference-load
ref_sum     <- T("reference", "reference_overlap_summary.tsv")
ref_matches <- T("reference", "reference_matches.tsv")
ref_ran     <- file.exists(file.path(params$tables_dir, "reference", "reference_overlap_summary.tsv"))
# Sample order and labels (patient, then cohort time, then compartment) from COMPARTMENT_OVERLAP.
ref_samples <- T("compartment", "compartment_samples.tsv")
```

```{r}
#| label: reference-section
#| results: asis
if (ref_ran) {
  cat("\n# Clones shared with reference studies {#sec-reference}\n\n")
  cat(paste(
    "::: {.callout-tip title=\"In short\" appearance=\"simple\"}\n",
    "- **What it shows:** which of this run's clonotypes are also present in external reference",
    "sets (`--reference_samplesheet`): earlier cohorts or iterations of the trial, or published",
    "clones of interest (tumour-reactive, antigen-specific).\n",
    "- **Why it matters:** clones that recur across studies point to shared, possibly",
    "antigen-driven responses; reference clones with a known target annotate this run's repertoire.\n",
    "- **How to read it:** bars give, per sample, the fraction of the repertoire (summed clone",
    "frequency) in clones found in each reference; the tables list the matched clones with their",
    "frequency in both studies.\n:::\n\n"))
  cat(paste(
    "Clones are matched exactly on CDR3β amino acid and V gene (`--reference_match_key`); a reference",
    "without V genes is matched on CDR3 alone (column *Key*). Exact matching misses similar but",
    "non-identical receptors of the same specificity; similarity-based matching (TCRdist3, GLIPH2) is",
    "not yet part of this comparison.\n\n"))
}
if (ref_ran && !have(ref_sum)) {
  note("The reference comparison ran but produced no summary (no clonotypes to compare).")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: reference-plots
#| results: asis
if (ref_ran && have(ref_sum)) {
  save_table(ref_sum, "master_reference_overlap_summary.tsv")
  ds <- ref_sum %>% filter(level == "sample")
  # Order samples by patient, cohort time and compartment; label with alias + compartment.
  if (have(ref_samples)) {
    ds <- ds %>% left_join(ref_samples %>% select(sample, alias, compartment, cohort_time), by = c("id" = "sample"))
    tl <- time_levels(ref_samples$cohort_time, trimws(strsplit(as_str1(params$timepoint_order), ",")[[1]]))
    ds <- ds %>% mutate(tr = match(cohort_time, tl)) %>% arrange(patient, tr, compartment, alias)
    ds$lab <- ifelse(is.na(ds$alias) | !nzchar(ds$alias), ds$id, ds$alias)
  } else {
    ds <- ds %>% arrange(patient, id); ds$lab <- ds$id
  }
  ds$lab <- factor(ds$lab, levels = rev(unique(ds$lab)))
  cat("\n## Repertoire found in each reference {#sec-reference-samples}\n\n")
  p <- pconf(plotly::plot_ly(ds, x = ~frac_repertoire_shared, y = ~lab, color = ~study, colors = pal,
                             type = "bar", orientation = "h", textposition = "none",
                             text = ~paste0(lab, " (", patient, ")<br>", study, ": ", shared_clones, " of ",
                                            format(clones, big.mark = ","), " clones; ",
                                            percent(frac_repertoire_shared, 0.01), " of the repertoire"),
                             hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>") %>%
    plotly::layout(barmode = "group", title = ttl("Fraction of each sample's repertoire in reference clones"),
                   height = max(420, 22 * nrow(ds) + 160), margin = list(l = 180, t = 60),
                   xaxis = list(title = "Repertoire (summed clone frequency) in matched clones", tickformat = ".1%"),
                   yaxis = list(title = ""), legend = list(title = list(text = "Reference"))))
  emit_widget(p)
  cat(paste("**Figure R1. Reference clones in each sample.** One bar per sample and reference set,",
            "samples ordered by patient, then cohort time and compartment (top to bottom). Hover a bar",
            "for the number of matched clones.\n\n"))

  dp <- ref_sum %>% filter(level == "patient") %>%
    transmute(Patient = patient, Reference = study, Key = match_key, Clones = clones,
              `Reference clones` = reference_clones, `Shared clones` = shared_clones,
              `Clones shared` = round(frac_clones_shared, 4),
              `Repertoire shared` = round(frac_repertoire_shared, 4),
              `Reference clones found` = round(frac_reference_clones_found, 4),
              `Reference repertoire found` = round(frac_reference_repertoire_found, 4),
              Jaccard = round(jaccard, 5), `Morisita-Horn` = round(morisita_horn, 4))
  if (nrow(dp)) {
    cat("\n## Overlap per patient {#sec-reference-patients}\n\n")
    emit_widget(htmltools::tagList(itable(as.data.frame(dp), pageSize = 10),
      htmltools::tags$p(style = "margin-top: 0.5rem;", htmltools::HTML(paste(
        "<strong>Table R1. Overlap with each reference, per patient</strong> (the patient's samples",
        "pooled). <em>Clones / Repertoire shared</em>: fraction of this patient's clones, and of its",
        "summed frequency, found in the reference. <em>Reference clones found</em>: fraction of the",
        "reference's clones seen in this patient. Morisita-Horn needs reference frequencies or counts",
        "and is empty otherwise. Per-sample values are in",
        "<code>tables/master_reference_overlap_summary.tsv</code>.")))))
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: reference-matches
#| results: asis
if (ref_ran && have(ref_matches)) {
  save_table(ref_matches, "master_reference_matches.tsv")
  cat("\n## Matched clones {#sec-reference-matches}\n\n")
  dm <- ref_matches %>%
    group_by(study, patient, junction_aa, v_gene, match_key) %>%
    summarise(samples = n_distinct(sample), max_freq = max(freq, na.rm = TRUE),
              ref_freq = suppressWarnings(max(ref_freq, na.rm = TRUE)),
              ref_patient = first(ref_patient), ref_labels = first(ref_labels), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(ref_freq = ifelse(is.finite(ref_freq), signif(ref_freq, 3), NA),
           max_freq = signif(max_freq, 3)) %>%
    arrange(study, desc(max_freq))
  emit_widget(htmltools::tagList(itable(as.data.frame(dm), pageSize = 10),
    htmltools::tags$p(style = "margin-top: 0.5rem;", htmltools::HTML(paste(
      "<strong>Table R2. Clones of this run found in a reference set</strong>, one row per patient and",
      "clone: the number of the patient's samples carrying it, its largest frequency in this run, its",
      "frequency in the reference (when given), and the reference's patient(s) and annotations",
      "(e.g. putative target). Per-sample rows are in <code>tables/master_reference_matches.tsv</code>.")))))
}
```
